items.excerpt: Suno has filed to block Universal Music Group and Sony's attempt to add over 61,000 recordings to their copyright infringement lawsuit, citing a similar denial in the parallel Udio case.

Suno's Chief Product Officer announced the company is exploring a developer API for its AI music generation platform, inviting developers to apply for early access through a curated partnership program.
Tidal will demonetize 100-percent AI-generated music while still allowing it on the platform, tagging such tracks so users know their origin.
Tidal announced it will not monetize AI-generated music and expects distributors to identify such content before upload. The platform begins tagging AI songs in mid-July.

TIDAL's new policy shifts focus from whether AI-generated music should exist to whether it should earn royalties, establishing that tracks deemed 'primarily AI-generated' won't be eligible for royalty compensation.

Tidal has implemented a new policy prohibiting royalty payments for 'wholly AI-generated' music beginning June 29, though the tracks remain allowed on the platform with dedicated labeling to distinguish them from human-created works. (Published date derived from page's own '5 days ago' timestamp.)

Apple released Logic Pro 12.3 with enhancements to Beat Breaker and Sample Alchemy plugins (including a new Granular Sync mode), plus improved AI-powered Chord ID detection that now handles extended chords and inversions.
Chiptune act YMCK released Magical FDS Plug, a free FDS sound chip synthesizer whose developer leveraged AI coding tools to overcome technical complexity that had stalled the project for years.

Download store Traxsource is introducing 'human-made' and 'AI-assisted' labels across its platform from July 1, partnering with AI-detection companies SH Labs and SoundPatrol; fully AI-generated tracks will be flagged for removal. (Published date derived from page's own '12 days ago' timestamp.)
Smol Sequencer is a browser-based modular sequencing environment with algorithmic/generative capabilities, where users patch interconnected patterns through the UI rather than relying on AI systems.

'Logic Pro 12.3 Update: Here's What's New!' — a walkthrough of the new Logic Pro 12.3 features, including the Beat Breaker and Sample Alchemy upgrades and improved AI Chord ID, from the Why Logic Pro Rules channel.

notes.coverage: Suno v. UMG/Sony lawsuit expansion fight; Suno developer API; TIDAL AI demonetization policy (4 outlets); Logic Pro 12.3 AI-adjacent DAW update (article + YouTube demo); AI-assisted free synth release (YMCK); Traxsource human-made/AI-assisted labels; browser generative sequencer.
